lines: Late shift, blue light, city gone still
No shortcut round it, just skill on skill
Days turn weeks, then the weeks turn years
I learned how to move through the doubt and the fears
sections.name: Intro

lines: I was down where the progress don't show on the face
Just a list full of plans and a room full of faith
Had the world moving quick, had to set my own pace
Put the pressure in purpose, gave the doubt less space
No handouts, no hype, no crowd at the start
Just a note on the wall and a fire in the heart
Had to make peace with slow, had to stay with the graft
When the road got steep, I got sharp with the craft
Every loss was a lesson I carried with me
Every "not yet" turned fuel when it rattled in me
I was building a life they could never just see
Brick by brick, deep breath, no retreat in me
sections.name: Verse 1

lines: When the noise gets loud, I go quiet inside
Keep the vision in front, let the discipline drive
I don't need the applause, I just need that sign
That I'm closer than I was at the start of the climb
sections.name: Pre-Chorus

lines: This the long game, long nights, same flame
Kept my head in the storm, never changed my aim
Now the weight in my chest got a new kind of name
Not pain, not shame — it's the proof that I came
This the long game, no rush, no pose
From the dust of the doubt to the calm I know
Every mile that I made put strength in my soul
I completed the goal, now I'm whole, I'm whole
sections.name: Chorus

lines: There were days I was tired but I still took a step
Couldn't see the whole road, but I honoured the rep
Made a promise to self, put the ego to rest
Stayed humble with the work, let the work do the flex
Specialised focus, got deep in the lane
Turned a scattered old dream to a measurable change
Not chasing a moment, I was shaping my frame
Till the person in the mirror knew my real name
I found worth in the follow-through, peace in the pace
In the hours nobody claps for, alone in the place
Now the finish line's here but it's more than a race
It's a life that I earned, it's a home in my space
sections.name: Verse 2

lines: No magic, no miracle, no borrowed glow
Just a reason to rise and a refusal to fold
If you're carrying a mountain, take it stone by stone
One day you look back and you're standing on your own

sections.name: Final Chorus

lines: Still moving, but I move with grace
No need to run when you've found your pace
Long road, one soul, one goal embraced
I became who I needed to be on the way
